text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My body feels light, and my movements 
don't feel sluggish at all.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, you hear.

Make sure you don't push yourself too 
hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That makes it easier to get injured, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The fatigue following the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) was quite severe, after all. I 
understand that all too well myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of that fierce battle in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring), Satono Diamond was 
left dragging heavy fatigue for quite some 
time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, we held back on intense 
training and focused on recovery 
adjustments, but it seems her body hasn't 
dulled in the slightest."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I'll be able to show my run to 
everyone who voted for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm off to the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, let's have another good day 
today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, Dia-chan! Sorry, sorry, I didn't 
hear you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I said hello/nice to meet you, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...Kita-chan, back during the Osaka Hai 
and the Tenno Sho (Spring), you were even 
more...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(If it's just my imagination, that's fine, 
but...)
